verdict.rationale: The release notes document that `-latest` aliases move on each launch ("This is now the model behind `gemini-flash-latest`") while versioned model IDs stay pinnable. A deprecations page tracks dated shutdown floors per model, which supports pinning. missing for 10: a dedicated, formal alias-to-version policy page (the policy is only inferred from changelog entries), explicit docs on versioned ID naming and pinning semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
